AWS restore does not copy source tags. After both restore waiters finish, a normal refresh-only apply settles read-only data-source outputs. This is distinct from the later strict no-change checks. The pinned provider leaves declared target tags for a later update. Save and inspect that exact plan, accept only empty-to-declared tags/tags_all updates on the two owned restore resources, reject unrelated or unknown resource/output changes, then apply the saved plan.
